name: Pebble Crew
summary: A sign-in page with four friendly shapes that watch you type and turn around for your password
about: A split sign-in page where a crew of four shapes (a pill, a triangle, a ring and a squircle) stands on a ledge beside the form. They follow your pointer, read along as you type your email, turn their backs for the password and jump in a wave with confetti when you sign in. Good for login pages of creative apps, studios and playful brands.
how: The page drops in: the crew lands on the ledge one by one and the form rises up
Move the pointer and every friend follows it with their eyes and leans a little
Type your email and they look at the caret, the closest one stretching up to see
Click into the password and they turn around one after another; press the eye button and they peek
Sign in with zara@demo.pk and chai1234 for the jump-and-confetti finish, or try other details to see them shake their heads
Sign out brings everything smoothly back to the start
